get.summary: List accounts with their current balance

post.description: Creates up to 100 accounts in a single transaction: if any item is invalid, nothing is created. Errors point at the failing item, e.g. items[3].name.

patch.description: Partially updates an account. The currency cannot be changed. Set archived to true to hide the account.

post.description: Sends a magic link and a six-digit code to the address if it belongs to an allowed user. The response is the same whether or not the address is known.
Provide either `token`, or `email` and `code`. Returns a bearer token for subsequent requests.
post.summary: Exchange a magic link token or code for a session

post.description: Creates up to 100 categories in a single transaction: if any item is invalid, nothing is created. Errors point at the failing item, e.g. items[3].name.

delete.description: Deletes a category. Its transactions are kept and become uncategorized.

patch.description: Partially updates a category. The kind cannot be changed.

get.description: Subscriptions, bills, installments and recurring income, with their next due date.

Detects recurring patterns among unlinked expenses and incomes, on demand. A pattern needs a description (digits and symbols are ignored) and, within the lookback: weekly 4+ occurrences in 2 months (+-1 day), monthly 3+ in 6 months (+-4 days), yearly 2+ in 25 months (+-7 days), with amounts within 15% of the median. Dismissed patterns are left out. Ordered by confidence.

post.description: Creates the recurring item and links the matching transactions to the due date closest to each one, atomically. 404 when the suggestion is no longer detected (or was dismissed); 409 when another active or paused item already has the name.
Hides the suggestion for good. Idempotent.

get.description: Active recurring items normalized to an average month and grouped per currency (no conversion), split into expenses and income.
